integrity: The finite-depth exact-arithmetic checker is supporting evidence; all infinite claims rest on the analytical endpoint/denominator proof. Priority against deductions of previously published general formulas remains a residual risk.
scientific_limitations: Exact jump-set and lower-count properties rely on the pre-existing positive endpoint expansion for stationary random beta maps. The theorem does not derive an entirely new invariant density or upper jump-count asymptotics. Dense-jump conclusion is almost-everywhere in the noninteger slope, not pointwise universal.
title: Arithmetic rigidity of stationary-density jump sets in mixed beta maps
